issue: M60 relationship-ontology wave — CLJ-D60 (a namespace does not export a namespace)
note: A MODULE symbol carries no `ownerName`, so the export pass pushed `undefined` into the array that indexes the `exports` edge's SOURCE and the edge pass resolved it with `?? currentNamespace` — the file's LAST namespace. Every file with two `ns`/`in-ns` forms therefore published one namespace exporting another. Measured 40 edges over 21 files of the 633-file corpus, e.g. `exports temp-ns -> clojure.test-clojure.ns-libs`. The fix attributes a module's export to the module's own NAME, which is the namespace it names, so the pass's existing `ns === e.name` rule refuses the edge exactly as it already refuses a Module row. A namespace is not lost: it reaches the graph as a SYMBOL, which is what `contains` and every traversal use.
